originality.rationale: A full-text inspection of the original Li et al. 2022 cosine-memory logistic map reveals numerical dynamical analysis but not the two-branch literal two-cycle census, the asymptotic density or return-multiplier law. Full text of a different 2022 discrete memristor logistic model was checked and found to have affine memory, not periodic cosine memory. Targeted semantic and bibliographic searches, and comparisons with pertinent previously published periodic-orbit results, exposed no statement implying the theorem. This is qualified best-knowledge originality, not a claim that unindexed sources cannot exist.

value.rationale: The natural full-state primitive two-cycle invariant of the published cosine-memory map has a nontrivial two-family arithmetic classification with sharp unbounded density 2k/π, distinct Jacobian orientations and diverging instability scales. Coexistence with a rigorously attracting inner strip shows the model supports very different recurrent geometry at small and large amplitudes. The exact facts are not a routine finite list or a special parameter case and are useful for interpreting recurrent trajectories of discrete memory dynamics.
